reviewed_by: Codex; independent fresh-context root-cause validation before repair
reason: A harness-session list page now resolves chat/run titles and first turns only for the returned session IDs through a backfilled, indexed projection. Focused Python tests cover title precedence, project scoping, pagination under unrelated history, projection updates, SQLite migration roundtrip, PostgreSQL backfill, and an authenticated non-loopback LAN Core refresh. The catalogued advanced-session-binding browser journey covers the visible resume selector in desktop Chromium, mobile Chromium, mobile WebKit, and a real-Core fixture.
exclusions: No UI source, provider call, harness execution, or native runtime changed. Frontend unit and native tests are not relevant to the server-side list query; the selected Playwright journey verifies the unchanged UI consumption of display names. Full Python and browser suites are excluded by the focused-test policy. Synthetic LAN fixtures do not use operator data or live providers. The PostgreSQL migration test is selected for CI's isolated database-migrations job; it skips locally without a PostgreSQL service. The legacy harness chat/mission integration test blocks during its synthetic completion before reaching the list route on this Mac; the selected route-level and LAN Core tests exercise the changed listing directly.
